svg.title: Deployment, maintenance and single-name TLS certificates
svg.desc: Git and separate secrets feed Semaphore. Serial deployment validates both edges. Maintenance uses its own coordinated playbook under the shared lock. Each edge independently obtains and renews single-name certificates using DNS-01, then validates and checks the certificate served by HAProxy.

div.style: color: rgb(243, 255, 251) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

systemd Certbot timer

div.style: color: rgb(255, 243, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Separate wildcard retirement
Audit live certificates + rollback snapshots
Revoke valid old leaves · remove managed copies

div.style: color: rgb(255, 243, 247) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scope limits
Single-name certs reduce one-key hostname coverage
An edge compromise can expose all its local keys
The DNS token is still a high-trust credential
